# Basic — Renormalization

Unformalized claims gathered verbatim from [wiphy.org](https://wiphy.org/) (query: “holographic renormalization”).

claims.name: holographic_renormalization_method_illustrated_detail
claims.statement: The holographic renormalization method is illustrated in detail for a massive scalar field on anti-de Sitter spacetime, including the derivation of the on-shell renormalized action, holographic Ward identities, anomalies and RG equations, and the computation of renormalized one-, two- and four-point functions.

claims.name: holographic_renormalization_prescription_cancel_infinite
claims.statement: Holographic Renormalization is a prescription to cancel the infinite contact terms by adding to $S_{\text{bulk}}$ the local, intrinsic boundary counterterm $\Delta S = S_{\text{c.t.}} = -\Delta_-\,\frac{\kappa}{2L}\int_{\partial\text{AdS},\,z=\epsilon}\sqrt{\gamma}\,\phi^{2}(z,x)$.

sources.title: Holographic duality with a view toward many-body physics

claims.name: any_renormalization_procedure_cft_side
claims.statement: Any renormalization procedure on the CFT side by adding local counter-terms $W[\hat{\mathcal{O}}]\to W[\hat{\mathcal{O}}]+R[\hat{\mathcal{O}}]$ translates directly to the gravity side as $W[\psi]\to W[\psi]+R[\psi]$, so CFT renormalization and holographic renormalization are in one-to-one correspondence.

sources.title: A Note on Multi-trace Deformations and AdS/CFT

claims.name: fundamental_holographic_relation_bare_relation
claims.statement: The fundamental holographic relation is a bare relation because both sides are divergent: there are UV divergences on the QFT side and IR infinite volume divergences on the gravitational side. So appropriate renormalization is needed to make this relation well-defined. In this section, we will show that the procedure of holographic renormalization for the spaces under consideration is {\it a priori} more complicated, but that none of these complications enter in the final result. Therefore, the formulas presented in for example for the holographically computed correlation functions remain valid in the context of our real-time prescription as well.

sources.title: Real-time gauge/gravity duality: Prescription, Renormalization and Examples

claims.name: holographic_renormalization_procedure_defines_renormalized
claims.statement: The holographic renormalization procedure defines a renormalized action from which correlation functions are obtained by functional differentiation.

claims.name: holographic_renormalization_relates_logarithmic_counterterm
claims.statement: holographic renormalization relates the logarithmic counterterm to another, quadratic counterterm and implies detailed balance

claims.name: hamiltonian_approach_holographic_renormalization_developed
claims.statement: A Hamiltonian approach to holographic renormalization is developed, with the radial coordinate playing the role of time, in which regularized correlation functions are related to canonical momenta and near-boundary expansions are replaced by covariant expansions organized by dilatation weight. This yields universal expressions for counterterms and one-point functions valid in all dimensions.

claims.name: holographic_renormalization_divergences_cutoff_action
claims.statement: In holographic renormalization, divergences of the cutoff action are fully determined in terms of sources by near-boundary analysis and can be expressed as boundary counterterms; the renormalized action $S_{\rm ren}= S_{\rm reg}+ S_{\rm ct}$ is finite as $\epsilon \rightarrow 0$.

sources.title: How to go with an RG Flow

claims.name: hamiltonian_version_holographic_renormalization_developed
claims.statement: A Hamiltonian version of holographic renormalization is developed that is more efficient than previous methods; a key simplification is that only the contribution of counterterms to specific correlators needs to be computed, rather than performing a general counterterm analysis.

sources.title: Correlation Functions in Holographic RG Flows

claims.name: coherent_approach_correlation_functions_stress
claims.statement: A coherent approach to correlation functions of the stress tensor in holographic RG flows is developed; holographic renormalization is valid for all solutions of a given bulk action.

sources.title: How to go with an RG Flow

claims.name: hamiltonian_approach_holographic_renormalization_yields
claims.statement: The Hamiltonian approach to holographic renormalization yields universal recursion relations for asymptotic solutions and counterterms that are valid in all dimensions, providing a faster algorithm for determining counterterms and correlation functions.

claims.name: both_gravitational_matter_conformal_anomalies
claims.statement: Both the gravitational and matter conformal anomalies of the boundary theory are correctly reproduced by the holographic renormalization method.

sources.title: Holographic Reconstruction of Spacetime and Renormalization in the AdS/CFT Correspondence

claims.name: systematic_method_renormalizing_ads_cft
claims.statement: A systematic method for renormalizing the AdS/CFT prescription for computing correlation functions consists of regularizing the bulk on-shell supergravity action in a covariant way, computing all divergences, adding counterterms to cancel them, and then removing the regulator.

sources.title: Holographic Reconstruction of Spacetime and Renormalization in the AdS/CFT Correspondence

claims.name: appropriate_counterterms_needed_holographic_renormalization
claims.statement: Appropriate counterterms needed for holographic renormalization are obtained.

sources.title: Topologically Massive Gravity and the AdS/CFT Correspondence

claims.name: holographic_renormalization_procedure_carried_out
claims.statement: The holographic renormalization procedure is carried out explicitly for two known RG flows obtained from the maximal gauged D=5 supergravity theory.

claims.name: procedure_holographic_renormalization_systematically_developed
claims.statement: The procedure of holographic renormalization can be systematically developed for RG flows dual to asymptotically AdS domain walls.

claims.name: paper_performs_holographic_renormalization_fermions
claims.statement: The paper performs holographic renormalization for fermions in AdS.

sources.title: Fermionic Operator Mixing in Holographic p-wave Superfluids

claims.name: hj_method_holographic_renormalization_removes
claims.statement: The HJ method of holographic renormalization removes ambiguities from the dBVV descent-equation method and consistently determines all logarithmic counterterms. Power divergences are completely removed by the first step, and the HJ method yields exactly identical counterterms to the standard method, with scheme dependence reflected only in finite counterterms.

sources.title: Holographic Renormalization and Ward Identities with the Hamilton-Jacobi Method
